what_this_is: How far each utility's place in the design rests on what the inventory does not know. Rules in docs/DECISIONS.md: D-44 (written before the first run) as Joe ruled on what it found (D-46). Load and sales only.
the_test: D-46, rulings 1 and 2: a utility keeps its place if the inventory as built (reading B) and with no anchoring (reading A) agree, in every state. Reading C, the state's remainder left unassigned, is reported and decides nothing. Ruling 4 as amended: it also has to keep its place with every unresolved site on it taken off and with every unresolved site that lists it as a candidate counted on it; those two cases are each utility's own extremes and cannot all hold together.
tolerance: the same group (early before 2011, cohort 2011 to 2022, late, never) and, for a cohort utility, a first crossing within 1 year of the built inventory's
assumption_reading_c_needs: hidden load does not shrink: load on a system in an earlier year is still there in 2024
